clips.title: The story
paras: In Teldrassil, hunters take fangs from the nightsabers prowling the forest. Woodland residents also seek these teeth as reagents.

Nightsabers hunt beneath Teldrassil’s canopy, among the deadliest natural predators of northern Kalimdor. Night elves revere them for their agility, ferocity, and deep spiritual bond with Elune. A hunter who kills one can take its sharp fangs as proof of skill. Some figures in the forest seek those fangs for darker rites.
